architecture.non_duplication_rule: The Guide references machine contracts from the POLIS Specification and does not define competing package layouts or apply semantics.

sdd: Define observable behavior, invariants, trust boundaries, scope, non-goals, and failure semantics before implementation.
Revise the versioned specification before changing a machine contract.
Treat accepted specifications as normative until explicitly superseded.
tdd: Observe a behavior-specific Red result before the production change when the behavior is testable that way.
Run the new test, affected tests, and complete policy gates.
Refactor only while protected behavior remains green.

invariants: strict coverage greater than the declared threshold
fail closed on unproven mandatory conditions

portable_trust_boundary.bounded_input: Treat .polis bytes as untrusted and reject archives, members, evidence lines, and command output exceeding normative bounds.
portable_trust_boundary.scope: Change Contract v2 declares scope.allowed_paths and producer plus consumer validate the base-to-target changed path set against it.
portable_trust_boundary.environment: Every executable schema-v3 command declares inherit or clean environment semantics; clean passes only named variables and never serializes values.
portable_trust_boundary.evidence: V5 command evidence persists byte counts, SHA-256 digests, truncation state, command identity, environment names, and semantic oracle results instead of raw stdout/stderr.
portable_trust_boundary.authentication: Detached Ed25519 signatures authenticate SHA-256 of exact .polis bytes when the consumer supplies a trusted public key; package contents never define trust roots.
portable_trust_boundary.preflight: Consumer preflight repeats package, baseline, isolated validation, target-tree, scope, policy, and git apply --check without applying the payload. Apply never reuses a previous preflight result.

delivery_workflow: Resolve repository identity, immutable baseline, permissions, changed/protected behavior, scope, and non-goals.
Inspect repository policy, current behavior, tests, CI, architecture, and material runtime evidence.
Create the Change Contract outside the worktree; V5 contracts explicitly authorize changed paths and command environments.
For defects, capture Red before the production fix through the canonical regression flow.
Run affected and complete repository policy validation.
Build with a clean index and exact baseline; producer scope validation must pass.
Verify the exact generated artifact bytes.
Optionally sign the frozen artifact with a detached signature; the consumer independently selects trusted keys.
Use inspect or preflight for non-mutating consumer evaluation.
Use apply only on the exact clean baseline; apply repeats validation and scope checks before transactional mutation.
non_goals: parallel or DAG gates without measured need
claiming hermetic builds from environment filtering
inventing language-specific init commands without repository evidence
